address: Katara Tower, Fairmont Doha, 6th Street, Marina District, Lusail City, Doha, Qatar
bio: The Fairmont Doha is a striking property by Lusail Marina and this Indian restaurant occupies a position on its first floor, with full-length windows facing the ever-changing landscape. The plush white surroundings are matched by a well-organised service team, while the kitchen produces colourful and artistically plated dishes – their kulcha is a must for enjoying the excellent dals. There is also a subtle influence from West Bengal so you can expect plenty of fish. Be sure to save room for the bebinca dessert.Currently closed for rebranding....
